scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof for all finite connected honeycomb subgraphs; finite computation is supporting diagnostics, not an infinite proof; all work is same-model reviewed; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Inclusive internal graph-distance threshold 2 only; finite connected subgraphs of the regular planar honeycomb lattice; not general cubic girth-six graphs, Euclidean metrics, or equivariant topology. Unindexed equivalent published work is a residual priority risk.
title: Scale-two Rips topology of finite honeycomb subgraphs with arbitrary missing bonds
